description:
When building `crate-jmap-mail-server` with the `sieve` feature enabled (e.g. `cargo check --workspace --all-features --all-targets`), the sieve method handlers fail to compile with 8x E0004 "non-exhaustive patterns" errors. `BackendSetError` is `#[non_exhaustive]` and the match arms in the sieve handler do not include a wildcard `Err(_)` arm.

Sites (all in crate-jmap-mail-server/src/sieve.rs):
- :391:19
- :543:19
- :705:19
- :751:23
- :802:35
- :832:27
(plus 2 more)

Reproduction:
```
cargo check --workspace --all-features --all-targets
```

Default-feature builds and the existing CI test matrix pass; this error is only visible when the `sieve` feature is enabled on jmap-mail-server. Fix is mechanical: add the missing `Err(_)` (or specific variant) arms.

Spotted while landing JMAP-g7wu.1.4 (ClosureHandler/CallerCtx forwarding); pre-existing on origin/main.
title: jmap-mail-server: non-exhaustive match on BackendSetError in sieve module breaks --all-features build
